purpose: Picks a value, or a range with two values, from a continuous scale by dragging a thumb or using the arrow keys.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value: one number, or two for a range

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled. Defaults to [0]

props.name: step
props.description: Step for arrow keys and dragging. Defaults to 1

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the value is shown, for example as a percent or currency

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the current value beside the label. Defaults to true

whenToUse: For approximate values on a known scale, such as volume or a price range
When seeing the value relative to the range matters
whenNotToUse: For a few named choices — use SegmentedControl or RadioGroup
antiPatterns: Hiding the value when precision matters
Steps so small that keyboard users need hundreds of key presses

anatomy: Label with the formatted value, a track with a filled part, and one or two square thumbs in 40px hit areas
typography: Label and value `type-label-size`, value in tabular figures
states: Fill and thumb `color-interactive-default`; rail `color-border-input`; hover, drag and focus `color-state-layer`; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`; disabled `color-border-disabled`
motion: Layer fades over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Each thumb is a native range input named by the label
Arrow keys step, Page Up and Down step by a tenth, Home and End jump to the ends
Fill and thumb keep 3:1 against the surface
